lines: Hum bhi piyen tumhein bhi pilaen tamam raat
couplets.en: Let us drink and keep your cup filled all night.

lines: Jaagen tamam raat jagaaen tamam raat
couplets.en: Let us stay awake and keep you awake all night.

lines: Unki jafaaen yaad dilaaen tamam raat
couplets.en: Let us remind them all night of the hurt they caused.

lines: Woh din bhi ho ke unko sataaen tamam raat
couplets.en: May the day come when we can torment them all night.

lines: Shab-bhar rahe kisi se ham-aghoshiyon ke lutf
couplets.en: May the sweetness of an embrace last all night.

lines: Hoti rahen qubool duaaen tamam raat
couplets.en: May our prayers find an answer all night long.

lines: Daabe rahi paron se nasheman ko raat bhar
couplets.en: All night she held her wings over the nest.

lines: Un gesuon ki li hain balaaen tamam raat
couplets.en: All night I blessed those tresses to keep harm from them.
